items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I miss hearing him myself... Never been around, I don't think.

ctx.x: Yeah, Simon, I've heard him play a couple of times. He used to be over playing with Punch a few nights, about four years ago. I haven't seen him since. Oh, another good pianist I missed hearing is, I can't think of it, Lewis, you know, with P-Roll. What's his name?
